ops.title: review PRs single-repo skew: diagnosis + 9.16.0 policy wave
ops.body:
**Question:** why did the continuous-improvement reviewer only ever open PRs against captain-hook?

**Diagnosis (2026-07-15, three parallel investigations + live DB):** 9 candidates ever reached `pr_open`; 7 targeted captain-hook, 2 cc-pool. Four causes: (1) *by design* — the scanning-sessions skill classified "generic behavioral" create candidates (signal: `seen_in_repos ≥ 2`) into captain-hook's shared general pack, and one user's corrections across ~28 homogeneous repos classify generic almost by construction (DB proof: candidates #693/#696/#854, origin cc-pool/cc-context/cc-notes → captain-hook PRs #11/#12 citing `seen_in_repos`); (2) 12 repos had the plugin's SessionEnd hook firing but no `repos` row (never ran `review enable`) — every scan silently no-oped; (3) the open-PR cap counted by the candidate's origin `repo_key`, never the PR's target repo — captain-hook showed "2/2" while GitHub had 4 open PRs, and origin repos' slots were consumed by PRs that opened elsewhere; (4) low eligible volume elsewhere (zero threshold-eligible candidates outside captain-hook at diagnosis time).

**Policy decision (user):** create candidates NEVER propose new hooks to captain-hook (shared by many users) — they always land repo-local in `.claude/hooks/`; only fixes to *existing* pack hooks target the pack's repo (`routing.py`, unchanged). Enablement became automatic.

**Shipped in 9.16.0** (commits `9d0424b2` feat, `a1b3f4d2` changelog, `01e7ac21` plugin manifest): generic-create route + `seen_in_repos`/`cross_repo_rules` deleted (SKILL.md + pr-workflow.md + review-cli.md rewritten fix-only); `review run` auto-enrolls unknown repos (`ReviewStore.enroll`, explicit `disable` sticks); open-PR cap counts by PR-target repo parsed from `pr_url` (`open_pr_targets`, single codepath, distinct URLs — #696/#854 share pull/11 — URL-less rows fall back to `repo_key`); new `review slots [--repo]` pre-`gh pr create` gate (exit 1 when full); `review update` rejects malformed `--pr-url`; `--repo` filters lowercase; `capt-hook status` canary lists unwatched-session repos. Review: codex finder + refuter passes; deliberately NOT fixed: GHE custom-port key mismatch (no GHE in fleet), URL-less `pr_open` consuming no slot (per plan), disable-during-brain race (pre-existing), legacy cross-target rows syncing only from origin repos (their sessions sync every pass).

**Ops done:** `review enable` swept the 12 repos (cc-guides, cc-runtime, cc-sentiment, cc-skills, cc-steer, cc-vigil, crm, ego, experiment-at-home, fusekit, reposync, slop-cop); plugin cache refreshed to 9.16.0. Live post-state: captain-hook `open_prs=4/2 free=0` (honestly over-cap until PRs merge/close/stale — builtin-pack fix candidates ineligible meanwhile, expected), cc-pool freed to `1/2`.

**Gotcha for future releases:** the consumer plugin cache resolves from `captain_hook/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`'s `version` field — it sat at 9.10.0 through six releases, freezing every consumer at a 2026-07-11 commit. Tag-driven PyPI versioning does NOT bump it; it must be bumped (or automated) per release.
